name: Marriage Assistance
benefit: A sum of Rs.10,000/- for both male and female is given as Marriage Assistance to employees or their Son/Daughter who legally attain the age of marriage.
eligibility_rules: Should have contributed to Labour Welfare Fund. Employee's monthly salary not exceeding Rs.25,000/- (Basic pay + DA).
documents_required: Marriage Invitation Original. School Transfer Certificate(TC) for both Bride and
Groom attested by Government gazette officersThe Receipt of the Marriage Hall / Temple / Register Marriage Certificate Xerox with
Government gazette officers attestation. Aadhar card and Ration card Xerox with Government gazette officers attestation. Salary slip of
the Employee. Labour Welfare Fund contribution Receipt Xerox. Name list of the paid Labour Welfare Fund. Bank passbook front page
